broker_split.title: Money split between brokers
broker_split.description_value: Each account's value over time, stacked. Combined today: {{total}}.
broker_split.description_share: Each account's share of the combined value over time.
broker_split.description_invested: Money in each account's holdings (cost basis) over time, stacked.
broker_split.note: Accounts start at zero before their first valuation; gaps carry the last valuation forward. Holding the same fund at two brokers does not diversify the underlying assets.
broker_split.empty_body: Add activities to at least one account to see how your money is split.

ro_tax.intro: How Romanian tax applies to each broker in {{year}}, assuming Romanian tax residence. Rules checked {{date}}; research notes, not tax advice.
ro_tax.so_far_none: No sales recorded in {{year}}. Holding, buying and value changes are not taxed; a sale or a distribution is.
ro_tax.so_far_sales: Recorded sales this year are taxed under each broker's regime below.
ro_tax.if_sold_note: From today's value and cost basis, in the base currency. The real figure is computed in lei, per sale.
ro_tax.deadline_note: Declaratia unica (form 212) for {{year}}. Needed if you sell at a self-declared broker, receive a fund distribution, or your non-salary income reaches {{threshold}}.

ro-intermediary.label: Withheld by a Romanian intermediary
ro-intermediary.rate: {{long}}% if held at least {{days}} days, {{short}}% below that
ro-intermediary.who: The broker withholds it on each profitable sale; final tax
ro-intermediary.losses: A losing sale pays nothing, but the loss is final: no offset, no carry-forward
ro-intermediary.filing: Nothing to declare for these gains; the broker sends a yearly statement by the end of February

self-declared.label: Self-declared (no Romanian intermediary branch)
self-declared.rate: {{rate}}% of the year's net gain; holding period does not change it
self-declared.who: You declare and pay it yourself
self-declared.losses: Losses offset gains in the same year; a net loss carries forward {{years}} years, up to {{pct}}% of each later year's net gain
self-declared.filing: Declaratia unica (form 212) by 25 May of the following year

ro_tax.holding_irrelevant_one: {{count}} recorded buy; holding period does not change the rate
ro_tax.holding_irrelevant_other: {{count}} recorded buys; holding period does not change the rate
ro_tax.next_lower_rate: The first lot reaches the {{rate}}% rate on {{date}}.
ro_tax.footer_self_gain: If sold today: net gain {{net}} (losses already subtracted) × {{rate}}% ≈ {{amount}} to declare by {{date}}.
ro_tax.footer_self_loss: If sold today: net loss {{net}}, no tax; up to {{pct}}% of later years' net gains could be offset for {{years}} years.
ro_tax.footer_unknown_cost: Net gain unknown: a cost basis is missing.
ro_tax.footer_none: This account is marked as not taxed in Romania.
ro_tax.footer_unset: Choose this account's tax regime to see its tax.
ro_tax.distributions_body: Dividends and fund distributions paid from 1 January 2026 are taxed at {{rate}}% and declared in the declaratia unica, even at XTB; foreign tax withheld may be creditable. Accumulating funds pay nothing out, so their growth is taxed only when you sell.
ro_tax.cass_body: Non-salary income is added up: investment gains (including gains already taxed by a Romanian intermediary, counted gross), net gains via foreign brokers, dividends, interest and rent. Salary does not count.
ro_tax.cass_note: Based on the {{wage}} minimum gross wage in force on 1 January {{year}}. Other non-salary income is not tracked here, so this page cannot tell whether you reach the threshold.
ro_tax.lei_body: Tax is computed in lei. For self-declared gains, purchases and sales are converted at the BNR rate valid on each transaction day, so the gain in lei can differ from the gain shown here.
ro_tax.unrealized_body: Unrealized gains and value changes are not taxable income. Tax arises when you sell, or when a fund pays a distribution.
ro_tax.disclaimer: Assumes Romanian tax residence. Rules change often; recheck before filing. Figures are rough illustrations from today's values, not a tax bill. A Romanian tax adviser should confirm anything you act on.

projection.title: Projection
projection.description: What investing a fixed amount each month could add up to, starting from today's value. An illustration, not a forecast.
projection.rate_label: If the portfolio returns, every year
projection.range: Across {{lowRate}} to {{highRate}} a year the result ranges from {{low}} to {{high}}. Today's starting value: {{start}}.
projection.chart_description: Hypothetical value at the chosen return, against the money put in.
projection.method: Starts from today's total value of all accounts. The monthly amount is added at each month end and the yearly return is compounded monthly, at the same rate every year. Nominal amounts, before future fees, tax and inflation. Real markets do not move in a straight line and can fall for years; the rates are assumptions to compare, not probabilities.
projection.empty_body: Add accounts and activities to project their value.
